citation.title: To Quantize or Not to Quantize: Effects on Generative Models for Topology Optimization Problems
citation.authors: Arthur Drake, Qiuyi Chen, Jun Wang, Seyed Ardalan Nejat, James K. Guest, Mark Fuge
citation.version_coded: Abstract only; publisher full text returned HTTP 403

claim.primary_outcome_paraphrase: The abstract reports that a GPT-2 model generates thermally performant heat-sink designs and preserves topological connections better than a WGAN-GP baseline.
claim.claimed_speedup_basis: No speed factor or timing comparison with a classical optimizer is stated in the accessible abstract.
claim.alternatives: The abstract also reports better topological-connection preservation by VQGAN than a continuous-latent autoencoder; these are learned-model comparisons.

baseline.quality_metric: Topological connection preservation and thermal performance (abstract; metric details unavailable)

notes: The accessible abstract says the approach is more effective than WGAN-GP, a learned baseline, and does not establish a classical-method comparison. Full text at the publisher link was inaccessible (HTTP 403), so the abstract-screen code is provisional.
